verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service platform, so built-in AI for ops is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no first-party AI capability: nothing on natural-language transaction search, AI-drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The documented dispute submission and account-locking features are manual or API-driven adjacent features, and llms.txt is documentation formatted for LLMs, not product AI.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
